#Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=This is a map showing a portion of the city of A Coruña, located in Galicia, Spain.
#Text=The map displays various neighborhoods and districts including Sagrada Familia, Agra do Orzán, Ventorrillo, A Gaiteira, Agrela, Elviña, and Matogrande among others.
#Text=The eastern part of the map shows what appears to be a harbor area with water visible.
#Text=Major roadways are highlighted in red and orange, including what looks like highway V-1.4 and AC-552.
#Text=The western and southern portions of the map show some greener areas, including what might be parks or undeveloped terrain.
#Text=The map indicates elevation at various points, with markings showing heights such as 105m, 74m, and 56m above sea level.
#Text=There's also a university area labeled "Elviña-Universidade" in the southern portion of the map.

#Text=The layout shows a typical urban environment with a dense city center and road networks connecting different neighborhoods, with some industrial or commercial areas like "Refinaria Repsol A Coruña" visible on the western edge.
#Text=Can you describe the most visually salient elements of the map?

#Text=The most visually salient elements of this map include:  The bright red and orange roadways that form a network throughout the city - these major transportation routes stand out sharply against the more muted background colors.
#Text=The blue harbor/water area visible on the eastern edge of the map, which creates a clear natural boundary.
#Text=The green patches representing parks and undeveloped areas, particularly noticeable in the western and southern portions of the map.
#Text=The labeled neighborhoods and districts with names like "Sagrada Familia," "Agrela," and "Ventorrillo" that help orient viewers.
#Text=The clearly marked elevation points (such as 105m, 74m, etc.) that indicate the topography of the area.
#Text=The contrasting urban density - with tighter street patterns in central areas versus more open layouts in peripheral zones.
#Text=The "A Coruña Provisional" marking near the center-right of the map, which draws attention as an important reference point.
#Text=The highway designations (V-1.4, AC-552) that highlight major transit corridors through the city.
